\section{Strange Markup}
Unknown commands should keep their argument text: \unknowncmd{kept text}.
Escaped specials: 50\% of \$100 is \$50, and an underscore looks like \_.
Em-dash---like so. En-dash--also so.
``Smart quotes'' should become straight.
A non-breaking~space.
A line with a manual break\\
following it.

\begin{itemize}
  \item First bullet.
  \item Second bullet with \textbf{bold} and \emph{italic}.
\end{itemize}

\begin{verbatim}
fn main() {
    println!("hello");
}
\end{verbatim}

\begin{unknownenv}
The body of an unknown environment should still be kept.
\end{unknownenv}

% This whole line is a comment and must NOT appear.

\paragraph{Aside}
A paragraph header should produce inline text.

\textcolor{red}{hello world} appears here.
\color{blue} and a stray color declaration drops cleanly.

\begin{table}[h]
\caption{A tiny comparison.}
\label{tab:tiny}
\begin{tabular}{lcc}
Model & Score & Time \\
Alpha & 10 & 1.0 \\
Beta & 20 & 2.5 \\
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

The Polish name {\L}ukasz should keep its leading character.
